title: Listen and Choose a Response — Neighborhood Shops

questions.stem: Why is the café on the corner closed today?

options.A: It opens again at seven in the morning.
options.B: I heard they're putting in new floors this week.
options.C: Yes, I'd love a coffee right now.
options.D: The corner of the room is a bit dark.

questions.explanation: A why-question calls for a reason, and new floors explains the closure.
